verdict.rationale: Kit is an email-marketing SaaS with a developer platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents a REST API, webhooks, OAuth, a hosted MCP server and a docs MCP, but never mentions an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent building blocks or different interfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
